discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: Geometric phases are foundational to modern physics, from topological matter to quantum control, and both have long been leading candidates. Recent prizes went to quantum circuits (2025), machine learning (2024) and attosecond physics (2023), so a foundational quantum-theory award is plausible, and Aharonov's age adds urgency.
